messages:
Eli (Marketing): Heads-up: webinar scheduled 2026-04-12 17:00 PT. Need coordinated X + LinkedIn teaser schedule, and two short X threads (4 tweets each) for dev audiences. Test matrix: creative A (benchmarks + charts) vs creative B (user story + quote). Metrics: CTR to reg page and % of comments flagged as high-intent. Also need a 20s clip + gif. Who can own creative assets and thread copy?

Rina (Social): I can own the publish plan and community responses. Proposal: staggered posting to avoid overlap with partner events on 4/9-4/10. Post cadence (UTC): X: 2026-04-08 16:00 (A), X: 2026-04-10 16:00 (B), LinkedIn long: 2026-04-09 19:00 (B), LinkedIn long: 2026-04-11 19:00 (A). Will tag variants using utm_content=variantA|variantB. Using shortlink rdw.ai/webinarQ2 for tracking.

Sam (Content): I'll draft: two X thread variants (4 tweets each), two LinkedIn drafts (long + TL;DR), and three quick reply templates (info, demo-ask, high-intent handoff). Upload ETA: 2026-04-01 15:00 PT to folder: /Marketing/Events/webinar-apr-2026/assets. Assets: hero_1200x628.png, clip20s_v1.mp4, gif_v1.gif. Note: keep clip music royalty-free; OpsBot please confirm.

Anika (Growth): Routing: use keyword detection + engagement signals to route to SDR queue. Rules: if comment/DM includes regex /(pricing|demo|trial|enterprise|contract|rfp)/i -> route as high-intent. Also if author has company domain in bio or >750 followers -> medium intent. We'll tag HubSpot contact with source=webinar_social_0426 and initial_interest=high|med|low. I'll provide Zapier mapping and HubSpot stage names by EOD. Quick question: do we want auto-reply DM for folks who ask "demo"?

Rina (Social): Yes, set an auto-DM for exact-match demo/pricing keywords: "Thanks! Sounds like a fit. Please share your email or register here rdw.ai/webinarQ2 and our SDR will prioritize follow-up." Keep DM minimal to avoid being flagged.

OpsBot: Reminder: Check music license and third-party clip consent. Maintenance window on 2026-04-07 08:00-12:00 UTC; avoid scheduling within that slot. Consent checkbox enabled on registration form: TRUE.

Eli (Marketing): Engagement playbook: Rina to post and follow up with two replies within 24 hours: 1) add a stat or slide snippet + link to slides; 2) pin a top reply with registration CTA for 48h. Sam to provide a 1-line hook for the pinned reply. Anika to create HubSpot view for "webinar_social_0426" and share access with SDR leads.

Sam (Content): Draft reply templates (pick based on signal):
- Info / low-intent: "Thanks! Here's the registration link: rdw.ai/webinarQ2 30-min run, recording sent to registrants."
- Technical question: "Great Q 30-min demo covers kernel-level optimizations and routing policies. Slide with perf numbers: rdw.ai/slidesQ2"
- Sales-handoff: "This sounds like a fit  can our SDR reach out? DM your email or register and we'll route you to the team."

Anika (Growth): Regex snippet for Zapier filter (copyable):
```
/(pricing|demo|trial|enterprise|contract|rfp|purchase)/i
```
I'll also add nuance: comments with >1 keyword or containing a company domain score higher.

Rina (Social): Amplification: we'll ask two partners (AuthPlatform, ComputeCo) to retweet on 4/9 morning. Also identify 4 developer advocates internally to amplify on their handles. I'll DM the advocates the copy.

Eli (Marketing): Outstanding items: Sam uploads drafts + assets by 4/1 15:00 PT; Rina to confirm Sprout queue links once scheduled; Anika to share Zapier->HubSpot mapping; OpsBot to confirm clip license by 4/2. Quick check meeting 2026-04-02 10:00 PT. Thanks all! :rocket:
